column1: However, the knowledge acquired with the results of the LISA-1 trial have enabled ROVI to use the time to progress with
the preclinical development of a new three-monthly formulation of letrozole (Letrozole LEBE), which aspires to obtain
plasma levels equivalent to those obtained with daily oral doses of 2.5 mg of Femara®. Currently, this candidate has
completed all the preclinical evaluation phases and is available to commence its clinical development.
